title.narrative: Strengthening Expenditure Management in Mongolia Building Institutional Capacity for Wage Bill and Establishment Control

description.narrative: The objective of this Grant is to provide core capacity-building technical assistance to the Civil Service Council (CSC) to strengthen human resource policy and expenditure formulation and execution in Mongolia, so that civil service expenditures are fiscally sustainable (i.e. aligned with the Medium Term Expenditure Framework, or MTEF) and effective in alleviating poverty (i.e. aligned with the Poverty Reduction Strategy Paper, or PRSP). The Grant focuses on strengthening the institutional capacity of the CSC to (a) formulate and oversee civil service policy, and (b) help the Ministry of Finance and Economy (MOFE) to more effectively control its size and cost. It has become clear that technical fixes to control civil service costs and size will not be sustainable without the development of capacity in the key entities tasked with the formulation and execution of civil service policy and expenditures. This has become urgent given the range of CSC responsibilities, from establishing many of the implementation arrangements for the landmark Public Service Management and Finance Law (PSMFL) to overseeing civil service policy and management. The Government of Mongolia has requested institutional development support for the CSC. The CSC needs urgent, intensive and focused institution-building technical assistance to maintain the momentum for change, and to prevent derailment of civil service reform efforts undertaken so far.
